text:
incident-bot: AUTO-ALERT INC-2026-0412 — sustained queue latency + token throughput spike on model family delta-11b. Backpressure thresholds crossed; routing moving to soft-fallbacks. Paging eng-platform.

alex.k: I'm on pager. Pulling metrics now — seeing a sharp TPM jump across multiple shards.

maria_p: Confirmed. delta-11b TPM from ~400 -> ~1250 over ~90s. Error spike to 502/504s for three tenants: acme-inc, nova-sys, beta-studio. p95 latency up ~2.1s.

leo: Early thought: this looks like a throughput saturation (KV cache pressure + attention kernel degredation). Live mitigation recommendation: 1) soft-sculpt delta-11b TPM 1250 -> 300, RPM 70 -> 20 2) disable funcall for delta-11b to cut external tool latency 3) enable fallback routing to delta-2.7b for tiered customers. Thoughts?

alex.k: +1 to sculpt and funcall disable. I'll run orchestration commands. Paging product owners for nova-sys — they're seeing timeouts.

maria_p: Applying quota change via orchestration agent now (propagation ~30s). Command I used:
```
# control plane CLI
control quota set --model delta-11b --tpm 300 --rpm 20 --reason "live sculpt INC-2026-0412"
```

incident-bot: Action recorded: quota_change applied by maria_p -> model=delta-11b tpm=300 rpm=20 (INC-2026-0412)

alex.k: Disabling funcall on delta-11b:
```
feature toggle set delta-11b.funcall false --scope all --reason "mitigate latency during quota sculpt"
```

leo: Also added a temporary routing policy to prefer delta-2.7b for non-enterprise customers to reduce pressure. Rule:
```
route if model_family==delta-11b and tenant_tier==free -> prefer delta-2.7b
```

maria_p: Metrics update: 60s after sculpt, queue depth dropping, 5xx rate trending down. acme-inc error rate back to baseline. nova-sys still seeing elevated errors (some requests truncated due to funcall off).

alex.k: Notifying product for nova-sys degradation: @sre-oncall can you take handoff in ~25m? I'll document steps and leave rollback plan.

sre-oncall: Taking handoff. Please post the exact rollback commands and the acceptance criteria for restoring normal quotas/funcall.

alex.k: Rollback plan:
- Wait for stable 15m where 5xx < 0.5% and p95 latency within 1s of baseline.
- If stable: run
```
control quota set --model delta-11b --tpm 1250 --rpm 70 --reason "rollback INC-2026-0412"
feature toggle set delta-11b.funcall true --scope all
```
- If regressions return, revert to sculpted values and escalate to infra/ML for kernel diagnostics.

maria_p: Current snapshot: p95 latency down by ~1.3s, 5xx rate at 0.4% (target <0.5%). Propagation looks healthy across regions. No new tenant spikes.

leo: Note: we should schedule a canary of re-enabling funcall only for enterprise tenants first, to limit blast radius. Also file an eval to check whether delta-11b quantization/kv cache tuning avoids future sculpt.

sre-oncall: Acked. Taking ownership of monitoring and customer comms for nova-sys. I'll keep this thread updated and escalate if above thresholds hit again. Handoff timestamp: 1742011600.

alex.k: Thanks all — creating follow-up ticket and postmortem stub. :+1:
